/**
 * Encodes the 2025 MCAL girls field hockey tournament (MaxPreps season 25-26) as a regression test
 * for the semifinal re-seeding rule. Proposed home: tests/mcal-bracket.test.ts, importing
 * '../lib/mcal-bracket'.
 *
 * Evidence (research/maxpreps-ncs/bracket-2025/bracket-2025.json, built by build-fixture.mjs from the
 * captured 25-26 schedules of TM RW MC LW UN plus the 25-26 league standings
 * https://production.api.maxpreps.com/leagues/a0fa5d87-b596-4001-adc2-95403ccb8a32/standings/v1?sportseasonid=8ae4cbab-caa1-4889-87a8-547fdaca9516):
 *  - Regular season = MaxPreps conference record minus the contestType-0 playoff games (SF, final).
 *  - QF 2025-10-28: 51473ec5 University 1, Lick-Wilmerding 0 (1 OT period; played at University);
 *                   8ca393c6 Marin Catholic 4, Convent of the Sacred Heart 1.
 *  - SF 2025-10-29: a3aee4a1 University 1 at Redwood 4; cb5f9d81 Marin Catholic 0 at Tamalpais 1.
 *  - F  2025-10-31: 3fb94e4a Redwood at Tamalpais (MaxPreps 2-1; actually 0-0, Tam won the shootout).
 */
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import { MCAL_FINAL_SITE, final, mcalPoints, quarterfinals, seedByPoints, semifinals } from './mcal-bracket';

const RW = '12616b84-157c-48d3-b353-434576d9df8d'; // Redwood
const TM = '7298608f-2310-4399-aa07-d6bc50df3f4e'; // Tamalpais
const MC = '69e24861-fa93-42a2-acb5-be60e01ee555'; // Marin Catholic
const LW = '527c7df0-94c7-4aa2-991c-ef86f4235d4e'; // Lick-Wilmerding
const UN = '7ad2b4f5-955e-4a92-ac1f-a1acced4df4b'; // University
const CS = 'd15d09d0-f8a6-463e-86d4-d998dbee7751'; // Convent of the Sacred Heart
const MA = '9f489fa8-a23a-4924-a2a0-5c5cff3c0fdc'; // Marin Academy
const BK = '6c68b5d2-1cab-449d-9140-bd7c8adb2791'; // Berkeley
const AW = '5cbb07ea-6b9c-4286-81f6-2708253e1add'; // Archie Williams

/** 2025 regular season (16 games each, playoff games removed). */
const REGULAR_2025 = [
  { teamId: RW, wins: 13, losses: 2, ties: 1 },
  { teamId: TM, wins: 12, losses: 1, ties: 3 },
  { teamId: MC, wins: 10, losses: 2, ties: 4 },
  { teamId: LW, wins: 10, losses: 3, ties: 3 },
  { teamId: UN, wins: 8, losses: 6, ties: 2 },
  { teamId: CS, wins: 4, losses: 10, ties: 2 },
  { teamId: MA, wins: 3, losses: 11, ties: 2 },
  { teamId: BK, wins: 3, losses: 12, ties: 1 },
  { teamId: AW, wins: 0, losses: 16, ties: 0 },
];

describe('MCAL 2025 field hockey tournament', () => {
  const seeds = seedByPoints(REGULAR_2025);
  const seedOf = (id: string) => seeds.find((s) => s.teamId === id)!;

  it('seeds by points: Redwood 40, Tamalpais 39, Marin Catholic 34, Lick-Wilmerding 33, University 26, Convent 14', () => {
    expect(REGULAR_2025.map(mcalPoints)).toEqual([40, 39, 34, 33, 26, 14, 11, 10, 0]);
    expect(seeds.map((s) => s.teamId)).toEqual([RW, TM, MC, LW, UN, CS]);
  });

  it('seeds Redwood #1 on points although Tamalpais matched its winning percentage and swept it 2-0', () => {
    const pct = (r: (typeof REGULAR_2025)[number]) => (r.wins + r.ties / 2) / (r.wins + r.losses + r.ties);
    expect(pct(REGULAR_2025[0])).toBe(pct(REGULAR_2025[1])); // 13.5/16 each
    expect(seedOf(RW).seed).toBe(1);
    expect(seedOf(TM).seed).toBe(2);
  });

  it('pairs the quarterfinals 5 at 4 and 6 at 3', () => {
    expect(quarterfinals(seeds).map((p) => [p.awayTeamId, p.homeTeamId])).toEqual([
      [UN, LW], // played at University in 2025 (51473ec5); the sheet's host rule says LW
      [CS, MC], // 8ca393c6, Marin Catholic 4-1
    ]);
  });

  it('sends the WORST remaining seed to #1 and the BEST remaining seed to #2', () => {
    // QF winners: #5 University (upset of #4 LW) and #3 Marin Catholic.
    const sf = semifinals(seeds, [seedOf(MC), seedOf(UN)]);
    expect(sf.map((p) => [p.awaySeed, p.homeSeed])).toEqual([[5, 1], [3, 2]]);
    expect(sf.map((p) => [p.awayTeamId, p.homeTeamId])).toEqual([
      [UN, RW], // a3aee4a1 "MCAL Semi Finals": University 1 at Redwood 4
      [MC, TM], // cb5f9d81: Marin Catholic 0 at Tamalpais 1
    ]);
    // The literal "smallest number at #1" reading would have produced Marin Catholic at Redwood.
    expect(sf[0].awayTeamId).not.toBe(MC);
  });

  it('is order-independent in the quarterfinal winners', () => {
    expect(semifinals(seeds, [seedOf(UN), seedOf(MC)])).toEqual(semifinals(seeds, [seedOf(MC), seedOf(UN)]));
  });

  it('plays the final at Tamalpais even though Redwood was the #1 seed', () => {
    const f = final([seedOf(RW), seedOf(TM)]);
    expect(f.site).toBe(MCAL_FINAL_SITE);
    expect(f.teams).toEqual([RW, TM]);
    expect(f.homeTeamId).toBeNull(); // fixed site, not "higher seed hosts"
  });

  it('refuses to seed through a points tie', () => {
    const tied = REGULAR_2025.map((r) => (r.teamId === TM ? { ...r, ties: 4 } : r)); // TM to 40
    expect(() => seedByPoints(tied)).toThrow(/tie-breaking/);
  });
});
